{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df.drop(qa_orders.index)

# Check for refunded orders
df_clean['status'].value_counts()"}
